source: thread-tube workcell, recorded state at t = 0.0745 s of L1_s1001 (thread stuck to the needle, entering the tissue)

parts.title: The workcell
parts.role: A gantry robot that carries a needle and a thread tube to a tissue phantom and inserts threads, one site after another.

parts.title: Base and deck
parts.role: The rigid table everything mounts to. The disturbance model treats it as an isolation table that still vibrates a little.
parts.specs: Nominal table vibration up to 1 mm/s² per component, 5–60 Hz.

parts.title: Gantry frame
parts.role: Two towers and a beam carry the X rail high above the work area.
parts.specs: Beam centre 465 mm above the deck.

parts.title: X stage
parts.role: Carriage running along the beam: moves the whole tool left and right.
parts.specs: Travel ±175 mm · moving mass 2.4 kg · force limit 100 N.

parts.title: Y stage
parts.role: Boom hanging from the X carriage: moves the tool toward and away from the viewer.

parts.title: Z stage (tool head)
parts.role: Raises and lowers the tool head with the thread tube; it carries the tool between sites and lifts it clear of the threads left standing.

parts.title: Microscope
parts.role: Optical head beside the needle with an oblique view of the work point. In these experiments its camera is for observers only; the controllers do not use pixels.

parts.title: Needle carriage
parts.role: Fast vertical slide that drives the needle: it strokes the needle onto the waiting thread end and on into the tissue, then snaps back.
parts.specs: Travel 0–18 mm · 25 g · 2 N · strokes at up to about 200 mm/s.

parts.title: Needle
parts.role: A conical point, a thin tip section and a stiffer shaft. When its point reaches the thread's end the two stick (a stand-in for a chemical bond), and the needle carries the thread into the tissue through a puncture.
parts.specs: Tip section Ø 50 µm · shaft Ø 100 µm.

parts.title: Thread tube
parts.role: Holds the next thread on an arm beside the needle, angled 15° from vertical, with the thread's end on the needle's path. It moves with the tool head, not with the needle's stroke.

parts.title: Thread
parts.role: The implant: a flexible 40 µm thread, drawn in lime. It is simulated as a discrete elastic rod (a published model for MuJoCo, arXiv 2310.00911, ported with a corrected force projection): 18 segments with bending and twisting stiffness, stepped at 50 µs with added joint inertia and damping so it runs fast.
parts.specs: Ø 40 µm · 8.25 mm · 18 segments · illustrative 100 MPa.

parts.title: Specimen support
parts.role: Tray and clamps that hold the tissue phantom on the deck.

parts.title: Tissue phantom
parts.role: A domed block standing in for tissue, with a needle-tissue force model: dimpling to puncture at 2 mN, then cutting and shaft friction, and grip on the thread inside. It moves with breathing and pulse in the disturbed runs.

parts.title: Target sites
parts.role: Six marked insertion sites. A three-site run places threads at sites 0, 5 and 1.
parts.specs: Ring markers 2.5 mm across (markings, no collision).

parts.title: Vessels
parts.role: Blood-vessel markings on the surface. They are markings for the task to avoid, not obstacles.
parts.specs: Main vessel Ø 1 mm, branches Ø 0.56 mm.
